info.name: Sonatype Policy Evaluation API
info.description: Operations tagged Policy Evaluation across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: sonatype-lifecycle-openapi.yml, sonatype-iq-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

variable.description: (Required) Enter the internal applicationId. Use the Applications REST API to retrieve the internal applicationId.

request.description:
Use this method to rescan older scans. This is done when the binaries of a previous build are now moving to a new stage in the production pipeline. Using this method, you can avoid rebuilding the application and reuse the scan metadata at the newer stage. This new evaluation will evaluate the most recent security and license data against your current policies.

Permissions Required: Evaluate Applications

response.name: The response will contain the statusUrl to view the evaluation result using the GET method (step 2)
